summary: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into the Tenth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment increases the credit facility commitment from $700 million to $1.055 billion, extends maturity from August 2029 to August 2031, allows borrowings in USD and GBP, reduces the unused commitment fee, and raises the permitted leverage ratio to 3.5x EBITDA. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
